SHARPENS ITS CENTRAL CLAIM RATHER THAN OVERTURNING IT, and the node stays open. That fact concluded the depth measurements were uninterpretable because every sample grew organically. TRUE, and incomplete: the flat ones are flat for a NAMEABLE reason that has nothing to do with organic growth — adopt's instructions never mention nesting, so a design it produced could not have been deep however deliberate its subject was. The contamination is not only 'no SE was done upfront'; for four of the seven it is 'the skill that built the model never asked for a hierarchy'.

WHAT STILL STANDS: no design shaped by SE upfront with reflow2 exists, flo2 remains the sole deliberately-shaped sample at n=1, and Conway's Law still means a conformant-looking boundary is not evidence that SE happened. What moves is that the genesis/adopt split now explains the BIMODALITY in the data — flo2 deep, everything adopt-produced flat — which that node treated as unexplained variance.
